mapper.select: select exists (select 1 from inv_trx t where t.item_id = #{itemId})

select s.stock_id, s.plant_cd, s.item_id, s.node_id, s.lot_id, s.stock_status, s.qty from inv_stock s left join wms_loc_attr a on a.node_id = s.node_id left join lot_master l on l.lot_id = s.lot_id where s.plant_cd = #{plantCd} and s.item_id = #{itemId} and s.qty > 0 and and coalesce(l.hold_yn, 'N') = 'N' order by s.lot_id nulls first, coalesce(a.pick_seq, 0), s.node_id

select s.stock_id, s.plant_cd, s.item_id, s.node_id, s.lot_id, s.stock_status, s.qty from inv_stock s where s.stock_id in #{id} order by s.item_id, s.node_id, s.lot_id nulls first, s.stock_status -- InventoryService.CELL_ORDER 와 같은 순서(docs/30 11.6) for update

select (select s.stock_id from inv_stock s where s.item_id = t.item_id and s.node_id = t.node_id and s.lot_id is not distinct from t.lot_id and s.stock_status = t.stock_status) as stock_id, t.plant_cd, t.item_id, t.node_id, t.lot_id, t.stock_status, -sum(t.qty) filter (where t.trx_type = 'ISSUE_MRO') as issued, coalesce(sum(t.qty) filter (where t.trx_type = 'MRO_RTN'), 0) as returned from inv_trx t where t.src_type = 'CMS_PART' and t.src_id = #{partId} group by t.plant_cd, t.item_id, t.node_id, t.lot_id, t.stock_status having coalesce(-sum(t.qty) filter (where t.trx_type = 'ISSUE_MRO'), 0) > 0 order by min(t.trx_id)

select t.src_id as part_id, greatest(coalesce(sum(t.qty) filter (where t.trx_type = 'MRO_RTN'), 0), 0) as returned from inv_trx t where t.src_type = 'CMS_PART' and t.src_id in #{id} group by t.src_id having count(*) filter (where t.trx_type = 'ISSUE_MRO') > 0
